$comment: Urdu shown in menus and headings.
These are baked into outlines exactly like the letters and words are. It
would be tempting to render menu labels with a webfont and Phaser.Text and
only bake the gameplay glyphs, but then half the Urdu in the app depends on
the platform shaper and the other half does not, and the two look subtly
different side by side. Everything goes through one pipeline.
Add a string here, run `npm run bake`, and reference it by id.
